text: ＊の　ポケモンは　じぶんの　ポケモンと　いれかえられません！

structure.jp: じぶんの　ポケモンと

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb says it can be done, and ません says it can't. いれかえられません = 'can't be swapped'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.span: じぶんの　ポケモンと
patterns.explanation: と after a noun means doing something together or against it. じぶんの　ポケモンと = 'with your own Pokémon'.
